Attribute.Name: PDX: Workflow States
Attribute.ValueTemplate:
<derive expr="{
    extWF:="PMDM.WF.ExternalSourceRecordHandling",
    extStates:=currentworkflowstates(extWF),
    extResultList:=iterate(extStates, "concatenate(replacevaluebylookup('PMDM.LUT.PDS.StateToName', item))"),
    workflowStatusResult:=substitute(
        list(
            listconcatenate(extResultList),", \n"
        ),"_",
        " "
    )
}
concatenate(workflowStatusResult)"/>
